summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and technical leader with over 6 years building production web and mobile products across the full stack, in roles from Frontend Lead to CTO. Shipped cross-border payment, Web3, and AI conversational commerce products using **React**, **Next.js**, **Angular**, **TypeScript**, **Node.js**, and **Go**. Works fully remote with distributed teams across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and the Gulf.

bullets: Own product and engineering for a marketplace matching students with private Quran teachers across booking, scheduling, and onboarding.
Direct growth operations for a remote-first tutoring network, including teacher vetting and search visibility.
Architected a **B2B cross-border payment** platform from concept to alpha in 8 months using **React** and **Tailwind CSS**.
Engineered **Node.js**, **Express**, and **MongoDB** services with **Python** microservices for financial data analysis and reporting.
Integrated **Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions** for institutional liquidity and shipped a real-time multi-branch liquidity dashboard.
Established CI/CD on **Firebase Hosting** and **Heroku** for continuous frontend and backend delivery.
Shipped **AI conversational commerce** features in **React** across 3 channels: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Discord.
Built **Go** and **PostgreSQL** services on **AWS** for high-concurrency messaging workflows.
Migrated the unified customer inbox from **Redux** to **Jotai**, cutting state-management surface area.
Built engagement analytics dashboards and instrumented the platform with **Datadog**.
Directed frontend architecture for a **Web3** social platform verifying cross-chain assets and NFTs.
Migrated a legacy **Angular** codebase to **React** and **Next.js**, improving load performance, SEO, and scalability.
Engineered multi-wallet authentication ahead of WalletConnect across multiple blockchain protocols.
Led a distributed frontend team and set coding standards, performance benchmarks, and automated testing.
Led frontend delivery in **Angular** and **React** across concurrent client accounts as senior technical consultant.
Engineered backend APIs with **NestJS** and modelled complex data in **ArangoDB**.
Authored software requirements specifications and phased development roadmaps.
Directed 4 technical functions — web engineering, UI/UX, IT infrastructure, and digital marketing — across concurrent client work.
Supervised offshore teams delivering **React**, **Angular**, **Node.js**, and **WordPress** products.
Owned budgets, timelines, and QA across the SDLC and hired full-stack developers, SEO analysts, and content strategists.
Set technical strategy and converted business requirements into Agile sprint plans.
Governed the delivery lifecycle through code review, testing standards, and deployment gates.

items.role: Full Stack Engineer, then Frontend Developer
bullets: Delivered full-stack applications spanning **React** and **Angular** frontends, REST API design, and schema optimization.
Shipped **Ionic** progressive web apps and hybrid iOS and Android builds with in-app subscriptions.
Integrated **Stripe**, Apple, and Google payments and configured CI/CD on **AWS**, **Heroku**, and **Firebase**.
Architected an **Angular** frontend and **Spring Boot** backend on AWS EC2 with Amplify CI/CD.
Integrated **Stripe Connect** across the stack to power a vendor-based marketplace and ran intern workshops.
Built an on-demand laundry marketplace in **Ionic** for iOS and Android, from concept to alpha.
Engineered a serverless backend on **Firebase Cloud Firestore** and Cloud Functions with internationalization for multi-region launch.
Deliver brand sites, e-commerce, and food-delivery systems for small and mid-sized businesses.
Build with **React** and **Node.js** alongside WordPress, Webflow, and Squarespace, integrating payments, CRM, and marketing automation.

items.organization: Effective Islamic English Cross-Cultural Communication Program
bullets: Facilitated cross-cultural communication workshops and coordinated a recurring community study programme.
Taught mathematics, coding, and STEM to students in grades 1 through 12.
